source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #162 (Giant Seahorse, Giant Shark, Giant Spider, Giant Toad, Giant Venomous Snake, Giant Vulture, Giant Wasp, Giant Weasel, Giant Wolf Spider, Gibbering Mouther, Glabrezu and Gladiator; PDF pages 288–289 and 353–355) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action, bonus action and reaction entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: Water Breathing. The seahorse can breathe only underwater.

traits.text: Spider Climb. The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Bite. Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

effects.name: Grappled

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: Swallow. The toad swallows a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn’t Grappled but has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad. In addition, the target takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the end of each of the toad’s turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time, and it can’t use Bite while it has a swallowed target. If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.text: Aberrant Ground. The ground in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.

traits.name: Gibbering
traits.text: Gibbering. The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn: 1–4. The target does nothing. 5–6. The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. 7–8. The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can’t make such an attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Bite. Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack. Its body is then absorbed into the mouther, leaving only equipment behind.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: Demonic Restoration. If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
